title: In sloot en plas
summary: "In sloot en plas" by Eli Heimans and Jac. P. Thijsse is a nature guide published in 1895. Part of the pioneering series "Van vlinders, bloemen en vogels," this work introduces readers to the living communities found in ditches and ponds. The authors explore how plants and animals exist together in interconnected ecosystems, presenting nature observations through fresh writing and original illustrations.
